reuse.why: Extends the existing getBulkActionCategories selection function with an option instead of adding a new query, and every month-wide action keeps calling it.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is decided once in the shared query; the only repetition is the necessary per-action plumbing of the flag through six signatures via a shared BulkActionOptions type.

placement.why: The rule stays in the category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, where the other bulk-action exclusions already live.

scope.why: Touches only the selection helper, the month-wide action signatures and targeted tests.

maintainability.why: One option on one selection function with a named options type is simple to own and extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) go through getBulkActionCategories.
